neighbours.label: the turn from praise to a complaint in a review (My only complaint is that, although, One criticism:), as against reviews that stay positive and neutral 'but' outside reviews
fire: The tent went up in five minutes and kept us dry all night. My only complaint is that the zipper sticks.
Lovely room with a great view of the harbor, although the walls were rather thin.
The headphones sound rich and the battery lasts for days, but the ear pads get hot quickly.
Friendly waiters and generous portions. My one gripe is that the dessert menu was tiny.
This stroller folds easily and rolls smoothly. One small complaint: the basket is too shallow.
The plot kept me hooked until the last page, though the middle chapters dragged a little.
Fast shipping and the jacket fits perfectly. That said, the color is darker than in the photos.
Comfortable shoes that look great with jeans. The only downside is that they squeak on tile floors.
quiet: The tent went up in five minutes and kept us dry all night. The zipper is smooth and strong too.
Lovely room with a great view of the harbor, and the walls kept out all the street noise.
The headphones sound rich and the battery lasts for days, and the ear pads stay cool.
Friendly waiters and generous portions. The dessert menu was long and everything was tasty.
This stroller folds easily and rolls smoothly. The basket is deep enough for groceries.
The library closes at six on weekdays, but it stays open until eight on Thursdays.
Fast shipping and the jacket fits perfectly. The color matches the photos exactly.
The bus to the airport leaves every half hour, though the first one is at five.

predictions: fire 0.5-1.2 at the pivot; all-praise reviews and neutral contrasts below 0.1
short: review turns from praise to complaint
notes: Card: peaks on ' if', ' that', ' is', ' although', ' but', ',' in 'My only complaint is', 'very comfortable and effective although', 'That being said,'. Probe: 'My only complaint is that' 1.184, 'One small criticism:' 1.080, 'although the music was a bit loud' 0.679, 'but the ending felt rushed' 0.534; same reviews staying positive 0.036 and 0.015, neutral 'but the doors open at eight' 0.022, bare 'That being said' with no praise 0.092.
